QUOTE: "If `roots:` is missing or empty, or the section has an unknown key or isn't a mapping, the build refuses and exits 1 ... It does not silently fall back to whole-repo"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a declared scope is preferred and that no section means whole-repo. It also says a malformed declaration makes the build refuse and not fall back, which contradicts "every failure falls through".
